sentence: Shi et al. close a study of Chinese listed firms by putting the spread in outcomes down to intangible complements, to how AI is governed, and to managerial capability that fits one setting only
passage: [Shi et al. (2025), p. 1] "These mixed outcomes suggest that the value-creating capacity of AI depends on more than technological sophistication alone; it hinges on complementary intangible resources, effective governance structures, and context-specific managerial capabilities---factors that current empirical research has only partially explored."
